77900.meaning1: what was said before; what was stated previously
77900.commentary: (MNa) purimena vā pacchiman'ti kāyadaṇḍo mahanto'ti iminā purimena vacanena idāni manodaṇḍo mahanto'ti idaṃ vacanaṃ. pacchimena vā puriman'ti tena vā pacchimena aduṃ purimavacanaṃ na ghaṭiyati.

examples.text: manasi karohi, gahapati, manasi karitvā kho, gahapati, byākarohi. na kho te sandhiyati purimena vā pacchimaṃ, pacchimena vā purimaṃ.
disvāna paccuggantvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā purakkhatvā yena kokanado pāsādo ten'upasaṅkami. atha kho bhagavā pacchimaṃ sopānakaḷevaraṃ nissāya aṭṭhāsi.

77902.meaning1: of a trainee; belonging to an apprentice; of a learner
77902.meaning2: learner, who is in the course of perfection
77902.commentary: (MNa) sekhāya vijjāya pattabban'ti heṭṭhimaphalattayaṃ pattabbaṃ. taṃ sabbaṃ mayā anuppattan'ti vadati. vitaṇḍavādī pan'āha, katame dhammā sekkhā? cattāro maggā apariyāpannā heṭṭhimāni ca tīṇi sāmaññaphalānī'ti (dha. sa. 1023) vacanato arahattamaggo'pi anena patto'y'eva. phalaṃ pana apattaṃ, tassa pattiyā uttari yogaṃ kathāpetī'ti.

examples.text: yāvatakaṃ, bhante, sekhena ñāṇena sekhāya vijjāya pattabbaṃ, anuppattaṃ taṃ mayā, uttari ca me bhagavā dhammaṃ desetū'ti.

77903.meaning1: what is useless; what is unbeneficial; what is meaningless
77903.commentary: (MNa) anatthasaṃhitan'ti na atthanissitaṃ. (MNa) anatthasaṃhitan'ti na atthasaṃhitaṃ na vaḍḍhinissitaṃ.

examples.text: sā kho pan'esā, mahānāma, brahmunā sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā no duggītā, subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā, atthasaṃhitā no anatthasaṃhitā, anumatā bhagavatā'ti.

77904.meaning1: has no desire to work; loses all interest in business
77904.meaningLit: work does not come to mind
77904.commentary: (MNa) n'eva kamm'antā paṭibhantī'ti na sabbena sabbaṃ paṭibhanti, pakatiniyāmena pana na paṭibhanti. dutiyapade'pi es'eva nayo. ettha ca na paṭibhātī'ti na ruccati.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa gahapatissa ekaputtako piyo manāpo kālaṅ'kato hoti. tassa kālaṃkiriyāya n'eva kamm'antā paṭibhanti na bhattaṃ paṭibhāti. so āḷāhanaṃ gantvā kandati, kahaṃ, ekaputtaka, kahaṃ, ekaputtakā'ti!

77905.meaning1: has no desire to eat; loses all interest in food
77905.meaningLit: food does not come to mind

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa gahapatissa ekaputtako piyo manāpo kālaṅ'kato hoti. tassa kālaṃkiriyāya n'eva kamm'antā paṭibhanti na bhattaṃ paṭibhāti. so āḷāhanaṃ gantvā kandati, kahaṃ, ekaputtaka, kahaṃ, ekaputtakā'ti!

77906.meaning1: you speak the truth; what you say is correct

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa ñātidāsī yen'āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa mātā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa mātaraṃ etadavoca, yagghe'yye, jāneyyāsi, ayyaputto raṭṭhapālo anuppatto'ti. sace, je, saccaṃ bhaṇasi, adāsiṃ taṃ karomī'ti

77907.commentary: (MNa) antar'antarā kathaṃ opāteyyun'ti mama kathāvāraṃ pacchinditvā antar'antare attano kathaṃ paveseyyun'ti attho.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, udāyi, api nu me sāvakā evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā antar'antarā kathaṃ opāteyyun'ti?
tena hi, brāhmaṇa, tvaññ'eva bhagavato sarīrāni aṭṭhadhā samaṃ savibhattaṃ vibhajāhī'ti.

77909.meaning2: analysed in detail; classified; explained in detail; dissected

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana ajānanto apassanto ek'aṃsena ādāya vohareyyaṃ, idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti, na m'etaṃ assa patirūpaṃ.

atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikkūlo. tam'enaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, api nu so puriso itic'itic'eva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyā'ti?

77913.commentary: (SNa) udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā'ti mahākucchikaṃ udakacāṭiṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā evaṃ bhagavā ca bhikkhusaṅgho ca yathāruciyā hatthe vā dhovissanti pāde vā, mukhaṃ vā vikkhālessantī'ti tesu tesu ṭhānesu maṇivaṇṇassa udakassa pūrāpetvā vās'atthāya nānāpupphāni c'eva udakavāsacuṇṇāni ca pakkhipitvā kadalipaṇṇehi pidahitvā patiṭṭhāpesuṃ. idaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā'ti.

examples.text: upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ āvasath'āgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññapetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telapadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu
sace kho tvaṃ, gahapati, sacce patiṭṭhāya manteyyāsi siyā no ettha kathāsallāpo'ti. sacce ahaṃ, bhante, patiṭṭhāya mantessāmi, hotu no ettha kathāsallāpo'ti.
atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, ayaṃ kho viṭaṭūbho senāpati rañño pasenadissa kosalassa putto, ahaṃ bhagavato putto. ayaṃ kho kālo yaṃ putto puttena manteyyā'ti.
evaṃ vimuttacitto pana, bho gotama, bhikkhu kuhiṃ upapajjatī'ti? upapajjatī'ti kho, vaccha, na upeti.

77917.commentary: (MNa) evaṃ majjh'āraññassa araññabhūtabhāvo veditabbo. mātaṅgassa pana isino vasena tadeva mātaṅg'āraññan'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante, sutaṃ me daṇḍakī'raññaṃ kāliṅg'āraññaṃ majjh'āraññaṃ mātaṅg'āraññaṃ araññaṃ araññabhūtan'ti.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, kin'ti te sutaṃ kena taṃ daṇḍakī'raññaṃ kāliṅg'āraññaṃ majjh'āraññaṃ mātaṅg'āraññaṃ araññaṃ araññabhūtan'ti?
sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, isīnaṃ manopadosena taṃ daṇḍakī'raññaṃ kāliṅg'āraññaṃ majjh'āraññaṃ mātaṅg'āraññaṃ araññaṃ araññabhūtan'ti.

iti puṭṭho no'ti vadeyya. tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ambho purisa, yaṃ tvaṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ icchasi kāmesi, jānāsi taṃ janapadakalyāṇiṃ, dīghā vā rassā vā majjhimā vā kāḷī vā sāmā vā maṅguracchavī vā'ti.
dhīrassa vigatamohassa, pabhinnakhīlassa vijitavijayassa, anīghassa susamacittassa, vuddhasīlassa sādhupaññassa, vesamantarassa vimalassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

77922.meaning1: turn to talk; opportunity to speak

77923.meaning1: giving fruit; resulting in; having consequences; with (such) outcome

examples.text: caranti bālā dummedhā, amitten'eva attanā, karontā pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, yaṃ hoti kaṭukapphalaṃ.

brāhmaṇā, bho gotama, evam'āhaṃsu, mah'aṭṭham'idaṃ mahākiccaṃ mah'ādhikaraṇaṃ mahāsamārambhaṃ ghar'āvāsakammaṭṭhānaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti, app'aṭṭham'idaṃ appakiccaṃ app'ādhikaraṇaṃ appasamārambhaṃ pabbajjā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appaphalaṃ hotī'ti.

77924.meaning1: under the Sublime One; under the Blessed One; under the Fortunate One; under the Buddha
77924.meaning2: under the Sublime One; under the Blessed One; under the Fortunate One; under the Buddha
77924.construction:
√bhaj > bhag + a + vant + ti
bhagavant + ti

examples.text: so'haṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etam'atthaṃ pucchissāmi. sace me bhagavā byākarissati… n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti vā, ev'āhaṃ bhagavati, brahmacariyaṃ carissāmi.
sace, bhante, na sakkuṇeyyaṃ ādiken'eva āhattuṃ, vāmena hatthena sīsaṃ pariggahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena vaṅk'aṅguliṃ karitvā salohitam'pi āhareyyaṃ.
so evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ kaṇḍaṃ jānāmi yen'amhi viddho, yadi vā gacchaṃ yadi vā ropiman'ti

77926.meaningLit: this can be expected for them

examples.text: evaṃ pariyāyadesite kho, ānanda, mayā dhamme ye aññam'aññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ na samanujānissanti na samanumaññissanti na samanumodissanti tesam'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharissanti.

77927.meaning1: (of the community) all present; all here; all in attendance

examples.text: tena bhikkhunā pucchitabbā, samagg'āttha, bhaginiyo'ti? sace samagg'āmh'āyyā'ti bhaṇanti, vattanti, bhaginiyo, aṭṭha garudhammā'ti? sace vattant'āyyā'ti bhaṇanti, eso, bhaginiyo, ovādo'ti niyyādetabbo.
subhāny'appaṭikūlāni, phoṭṭhabbāni anussaraṃ, ratto rāg'ādhikaraṇaṃ, vividhaṃ vindate dukhaṃ.
kiṃ pan'udāyi, atthi ek'antasukho loko, atthi ākāravatī paṭipadā ek'antasukhassa lokassa sacchikiriyāyā'ti?
sakkā ca tāvataken'eva balamattena abhivijinituṃ. abhivijina, mahārājā'ti, kin'ti naṃ kareyyāsī'ti? tam'pi mayaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, abhivijiya ajjhāvaseyyāmā'ti.

77932.meaning1: having regained one's strength; having recovered one's energy
77932.commentary: (VINa) balaṃ gāhetvā'ti sappāyabhojanāni bhuñjanto, ucchādananhāpan'ādīhi ca kāyaṃ pariharanto, kāyabalaṃ janetvā

examples.text: atha kho raṭṭhapālo kulaputto uṭṭhahitvā balaṃ gāhetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho raṭṭhapālo kulaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, anuññāto ahaṃ, bhante, mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāya.

77933.meaning1: (of strength) having regained; having recovered; having got back
77933.commentary: (VINa) balaṃ gāhetvā'ti sappāyabhojanāni bhuñjanto, ucchādananhāpan'ādīhi ca kāyaṃ pariharanto, kāyabalaṃ janetvā

examples.text: atha kho raṭṭhapālo kulaputto uṭṭhahitvā balaṃ gāhetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho raṭṭhapālo kulaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, anuññāto ahaṃ, bhante, mātāpitūhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāya.

77934.commentary: (MNa) sabbe jīvā'ti sāliyavagodhum'ādayo sandhāya vadanti. tesu h'ete viruhanabhāvena jīvasaññino.

examples.text: sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chasv'ev'ābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti.

77935.meaning1: similarity; equality; conformity; the same state
77935.commentary: (MNa) samasamā'ti ativiya samā, samena vā guṇena samā. sāmaññaṃ pattā'ti samānabhāvaṃ pattā.

examples.text: sace imassa bhoto satthuno saccaṃ vacanaṃ, akatena me ettha kataṃ, avusitena me ettha vusitaṃ. ubho'pi mayaṃ ettha samasamā sāmaññaṃ pattā, yo c'āhaṃ na vadāmi ubho kāyassa bhedā ucchijjissāma, vinassissāma, na bhavissāma paraṃ maraṇā'ti.

77936.meaning1: should be explained; should be clarified; should be elucidated

examples.text: yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu.
yā tā devatā ek'antasukhaṃ lokaṃ upapannā tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṃ samāpajjati. ettāvatā khv'āssa, udāyi, ek'antasukho loko sacchikato hotī'ti.
no ce bhagavā jānāti, sassato loko'ti vā, asassato loko'ti vā, ajānato kho pana apassato etadeva ujukaṃ hoti yadidaṃ, na jānāmi, na passāmī'ti.

77940.meaning1: by which I am; with which I am

examples.text: so evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ jiyaṃ jānāmi yāy'amhi viddho, yadi vā akkassa yadi vā saṇhassa yadi vā nhārussa yadi vā maruvāya yadi vā khīrapaṇṇino'ti.

77941.meaning1: type of bowstring made from bamboo

examples.text: so evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ jiyaṃ jānāmi yāy'amhi viddho, yadi vā akkassa yadi vā saṇhassa yadi vā nhārussa yadi vā maruvāya yadi vā khīrapaṇṇino'ti.

77946.grammar: pr, pass of appeti, caus, trans (+acc & +loc)

77947.meaning2: like, similar, having the qualities of

examples.text: nanu, mālukyaputta, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā iminā taruṇa-upamena upārambhena upārambhissanti?

77948.meaning1: having breasted the stream; having swum across

examples.text: atha dubbalako puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imissā gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gacchissāmī'ti, so na sakkuṇeyya gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gantuṃ.

77949.meaning1: (of a river or saṃsāra) goes across; goes to the other side; makes it across
77949.commentary: (NIDD1) pāraṃ gaccheyyā'ti, pāraṃ adhigaccheyya, pāraṃ phuseyya, pāraṃ sacchikareyya.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, gaṅgā nadī pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā. atha balavā puriso āgaccheyya, ahaṃ imissā gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gacchissāmī'ti, so sakkuṇeyya gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gantuṃ.
nāvā santāraṇī uttarasetu vā apārā pāraṃ gamanāya. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ saṃkaḍḍhitvā kullaṃ bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ gaccheyyan'ti.

77950.commentary: (DNa) samāpattimatten'eva kammaṃ na nipphajjatī'ti jhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā saṅkhāre sammasitvā saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti, ayaṃ upadhiviveko nāma. (DHPa) upadhiviveko'ti nibbānaṃ.

examples.text: cātumahābhūtiko ayaṃ puriso yadā kālaṅ'karoti, pathavī pathavīkāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, āpo āpokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, tejo tejokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, vāyo vāyokāyaṃ anupeti anupagacchati, ākāsaṃ indriyāni saṅkamanti.

77954.meaning1: who has attained the path of stream entry though faith
77954.commentary: (MNa) dhamm'ānusārino saddh'ānusārino'ti ime dve sot'āpattimaggaṭṭhā honti… katamo ca puggalo saddh'ānusārī? yassa puggalassa sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa saddh'indriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti, saddhāvāhiṃ saddhāpubbaṅ'gamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ bhāveti. ayaṃ vuccati puggalo saddh'ānusārī. sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo saddh'ānusārī, phale ṭhito saddhāvimutto'ti (pu. pa. 30).

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, api nu tvaṃ, bhaddāli, tasmiṃ samaye ubhatobhāgavimutto vā hosi paññāvimutto vā kāyasakkhi vā diṭṭhippatto vā saddhāvimutto vā dhamm'ānusārī vā saddh'ānusārī vā'ti?

77957.commentary: (MNa) adhicc'āpattiko'ti kadāci kadāci āpattiṃ āpajjati. so kiñ'c'āpi lajjī hoti pakatatto, dubbacattā pan'assa bhikkhū tath'eva paṭipajjanti.
77957.notes: The Sanskrit uddhṛtya 'exception' suggests that the correct etymology is ud √dhar.

examples.text: idha, bhaddāli, ekacco bhikkhu adhicc'āpattiko hoti anāpattibahulo.

77958.commentary: (MNa) saddhāmattakena vahati pemamattakenā'ti ācariy'upajjhāyesu appamattikāya gehassitasaddhāya appamattakena gehassitapemena yāpeti. paṭisandhiggahaṇasadisā hi ayaṃ pabbajjā nāma, navapabbajito pabbajjāya guṇaṃ ajānanto ācariy'upajjhāyesu pemamattena yāpeti, tasmā evarūpā saṅgaṇhitabbā. appamattakam'pi hi saṅgahaṃ labhitvā pabbajjāya ṭhitā abhiññāpattā mahāsamaṇā bhavissanti. ettakena kathāmaggena ovaditabbayuttakaṃ ovadanti, na itaran'ti imam'eva bhagavatā dassitaṃ.

examples.text: tatra, bhaddāli, bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saddhāmattakena vahati pemamattakena. sace mayaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ pasayha pasayha kāraṇaṃ karissāma, mā yam'pi'ssa taṃ saddhāmattakaṃ pemamattakaṃ tamhā'pi parihāyī'ti.

77962.commentary: (MNa) ājānīyasus'ūpamaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ desesin'ti taruṇ'ājānīyaupamaṃ katvā dhammaṃ desayiṃ.

examples.text: appakā kho tumhe, bhaddāli, tena samayena ahuvattha yadā vo ahaṃ ājānīya-susu-upamaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ desesiṃ.

77964.meaning1: (of bad behaviour) settles down; cool down; subsides (in)
77964.commentary: (MNa) tasmiṃ ṭhāne'ti tasmiṃ visevan'ācāre. parinibbāyatī'ti nibbisevano hoti, taṃ visevanaṃ jahatī'ti attho.

examples.text: so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati. yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti yug'ādhāne.

77965.meaning1: (of bad behaviour) settled down; cooled down; subsided (wrt)

examples.text: so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati. yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti yug'ādhāne.

77966.meaning1: (of a horse) walking in line; going in order; (comm) raising and lower all four legs at the same time
77966.commentary: (MNa) anukkame'ti cattāro'pi pāde ekappahāren'eva ukkhipane ca nikkhipane ca. parasenāya hi āvāṭe ṭhatvā asiṃ gahetvā āgacchantassa assassa pāde chindanti. tasmiṃ samaye esa ekappahāren'eva cattāro'pi pāde ukkhipissatī'ti rajjubandhanavidhānena etaṃ kāraṇaṃ karonti.

77967.meaning1: (of a horse) lunging; walking in the ring; (comm) reaching a weapon on the ground while seated on a horse

examples.text: yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāse dhāve davatte rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye.

77968.commentary: (MNa) khurakāse'ti agg'aggakhurehi pathavīkamane. rattiṃ okkantakaraṇasmiñ'hi yathā padasaddo na suyyati, tadatthaṃ ekasmiṃ ṭhāne saññaṃ datvā agg'aggakhurehi'y'eva gamanaṃ sikkhāpenti. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati. yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāse dhāve davatte rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye.

77971.meaning1: (of a horse) protecting the royal lineage
77971.commentary: (MNa) rājavaṃse'ti assarājavaṃse. vaṃso c'eso assarājānaṃ, tathārūpena pahārena chinnabhinnasarīrā'pi ass'ārohaṃ parasenāya apātetvā bahi nīharanti'y'eva. etadatthaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāretī'ti attho. (MNt) assarājavaṃse'ti dussahaṃ dukkhaṃ patvā'pi yathā ayaṃ rājavaṃs'ānurūpakiriyaṃ na jahissati, evaṃ sikkhāpane.

examples.text: yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāse dhāve davatte rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye.

77972.commentary: (MNa) uttame haye'ti uttamahayabhāve, yathā uttamahayo hoti, evaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāretī'ti attho. tattha pakatiyā uttamahayo'va uttamahayakāraṇaṃ arahati, na añño. uttamahayakāraṇāya eva ca hayo uttamajavaṃ paṭipajjati, na añño'ti.
